issues.desc: background.md Conversation Texture lists 7 prior story IDs (B-253e/B-08a1/B-a5c9/B-97df/B-0f7c/B-dd44/B-fd64) as a lineage chain with no one-sentence explanation per story for a new reader. B-0f7c and B-dd44 are covered in Key Insight and Description, but the remaining 5 are opaque to a reader without conversation history.

Title and description reference spec Rollout Phase 6 but background.md never defines the Rollout Phase scheme or what phases 1-5 established. A new reader cannot independently verify what the phase sequence means or whether prior phases are prerequisites.
